findings.message: `read_upload` joins a client-supplied name onto `UPLOAD_DIR` without validation. Names such as `../../etc/passwd`, or an absolute path (which replaces the base entirely in pathlib), let any caller read arbitrary files on the server.

The `download` handler never identifies the requesting user or checks that the requested file belongs to them. Any client can fetch any other user's uploads by guessing or enumerating names, for example `<user_id>.png` avatars.

Decoding the file as UTF-8 raises `UnicodeDecodeError` for binary uploads such as the PNG avatars stored in the same directory. A missing or empty `file` parameter raises `FileNotFoundError` or `IsADirectoryError`. All of these surface as unhandled 500s instead of returning the bytes or a 404.
This new download behaviour ships without any test. The contributing guide requires a test for every change in behaviour.
